title: Reports of Electronic Waste in Green Spaces Like Clementi Forest
what_it_is: Reports of Electronic Waste in Green Spaces Like Clementi Forest

sections.label: Bulky e-waste feedback acted upon
sections.summary: Two instances of feedback on improper disposal of bulky electronic waste in forested areas were received and acted upon by agencies from January 2021 to March 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Two instances of feedback on improper disposal of bulky electronic waste in forested areas were received and acted upon by agencies from January 2021 to March 2023.

sections.label: Clementi Forest refrigerator removal coordination
sections.summary: A refrigerator found on state land in Clementi Forest was cleared on 21 April 2023 after a miscommunication between agencies delayed its earlier removal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Lapses in communication and coordination between agencies sometimes occur, as in the case of the refrigerator found on state land in Clementi Forest.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The National Parks Board (NParks) was first alerted to the incident in March 2022 through the OneService App and sought to arrange for its removal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Unfortunately, due to a miscommunication between agencies, the removal was not done and the case was closed prematurely.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There was also no follow-through to check that the refrigerator had, indeed, been cleared.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Upon being notified a second time, in 2023, NParks worked with the National Environment Agency (NEA) to clear the refrigerator on 21 April 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: MSO has been working with stakeholder agencies to strengthen interagency coordination and this includes NParks and NEA.

sections.label: Clementi Forest not for recreation
sections.summary: Clementi Forest is not intended for public recreational use at this point in time.
